# Meeting brief: Saigon Fresh Foods

- Profile: Saigon Fresh Foods — Packaged foods, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, about 3,000 staff, 2 factories. Saigon Fresh Foods makes chilled ready meals and sauces for supermarkets in Vietnam and exports to Japan.
- Email from Minh Pham: Revisiting AI after our export expansion — Hi, as discussed in March, we'd like to look again at automating supplier invoices. Our export line to Japan is live now. See you Friday. Minh
- Contact: Minh Pham, Head of IT
- Contact: Thu Le, Customer Service Director
- History 2025-11-12 (pilot): Customer-service chatbot pilot for order questions. Good accuracy; paused in Jan 2026 for budget.
- History 2026-03-04 (call): Minh Pham asked to revisit after the export expansion. Main pain: supplier invoices typed by hand.
- Meeting 2026-10-09 14:00:00: Follow-up: invoice automation
